GruntWorx should inherit the operational safeguards from Instead, with its own vendor limits and mappings. The existing code supports five concrete lessons:

1. **Rate limits need two budgets and explicit retry semantics.** Instead throttles each API group per connection, then the entire app. The group check runs first so rejected jobs do not consume app capacity. Defaults are 500 app requests/minute and 5 `docs` requests/minute per connection; production config raises these to 3,000 and 60. GruntWorx needs independently confirmed values. Honour `Retry-After` as seconds or an HTTP date, and expose remaining/reset metrics. The shared retry budget is 10 retries, roughly 4½ hours, but throttling resets the attempt count: **this is not a wall-clock deadline**. See [throttles](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb:101), [production limits](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/settings/production.yml:187), and [retry policy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:9).

2. **Lost webhooks require bounded reconciliation.** The sweep runs every 30 minutes, selecting uploaded documents still `sent` after one hour or `processing` after 12 hours, within a two-day window measured from `uploaded_at`. Older records remain unchanged. Instead groups reads by entity/year, paginates, then individually fetches files absent from the listing: a file may have moved folders; an individual 404 maps to `archived`. Webhooks and reconciliation share `ApplyProcessingStatus`, preventing divergent mappings. Reconciliation page jobs get one attempt; the next sweep supplies recovery. GruntWorx should explicitly choose these windows and define recovery after they expire. See [candidate bounds](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8) and [pagination/fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:34).

3. **Keep a stable failure vocabulary, with vendor-specific translation.** Shared reasons are `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, and `encrypted`. Instead translates `password_required` to `encrypted`; other indexing failures become `error` without a reason. Quota exhaustion differs from temporary rate limiting. Unknown reconciliation statuses are logged and skipped. Repeated statuses are idempotent, and recovery from `error` to `processed` passes through `processing`. GruntWorx should supply explicit mappings without inventing misleading reasons. See [shared model](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:12), [refusal mapping](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/refusals_helper.rb:24), and [Instead translation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:8).

4. **Signed-upload cassettes need both sanitization and realistic replay.** Global recording hooks scrub policy, credential, signature, and client-secret fields from request and response bodies; Instead traffic additionally scrubs bearer credentials and tokens. Those OAuth rules are host-specific, so GruntWorx needs equivalent coverage. Replay freezes time at the cassette’s original recording time, keeping `ExpiresAt` meaningful; new recordings use real time. Also assert important request payloads explicitly: the Instead specs document that cassette matching does not check the body. See [recording hooks](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/spec_helper.rb:182), [clock handling](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3), and [client replay tests](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/unit/tax_preparation/lib/tax_automations/instead/client_spec.rb:5).

5. **Entity matching should be conservative, local, and observable.** Instead first reuses an active local association scoped by firm, account, contact, and entity type, across tax years. Name matching considers only active, unlinked entities of the correct type and links exactly one candidate. It normalizes punctuation, whitespace, case, and business legal-form spellings; person matching tries swapped names only after no direct match, and uses the account name only for a sole contact. Ambiguity produces no link and emits a matching outcome metric. Entity sync archives unseen records only after the final page and protects records created or updated during the pass. Preserve these safeguards while validating GruntWorx’s identity model. See [association lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/find_entity.rb:32), [matching](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:48), and [sync safeguards](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/sync_entities_page.rb:45).

This was a read-only code analysis; no files were changed.
